scenarios.name: Hero Section Display and Value Proposition
scenarios.description: Verify that the homepage hero section displays correctly with headline, tagline, and call-to-action buttons that communicate the URL shortening service's value proposition

steps.description: Access the root URL (/) of the application
steps.context: User is a first-time visitor with no authentication

steps.description: Check that the hero section contains a prominent headline about URL shortening and analytics
steps.context: Hero section should be visible above the fold

steps.description: Confirm presence of primary CTA (Get Started/Sign Up) and secondary CTA (Sign In)
steps.context: Buttons should use FuturisticButton component styling

steps.description: Check that BackgroundEffect component renders correctly behind hero content
steps.context: Background should be animated and visually consistent with app theme

test_cases.expected: Hero section displays with headline containing 'Shorten URLs' or similar value proposition text
Button with text 'Get Started' or 'Create Free Account' is present and visible
Button or link with text 'Sign In' or 'Login' is present and visible
BackgroundEffect component is present in the DOM

scenarios.name: Navigation to Registration Page

steps.description: Access the root URL (/) of the application
Click the 'Get Started' or 'Sign Up' button in the hero section
Confirm user is redirected to /register route

test_cases.input: Click primary CTA button (Get Started/Sign Up)
test_cases.expected: Navigation occurs to '/register' route
Link/button has href='/register' or onClick navigates to '/register'

scenarios.name: Navigation to Login Page

steps.description: Access the root URL (/) of the application

steps.description: Find the 'Sign In' or 'Login' link/button
steps.context: Should be visible in hero section or navigation

steps.description: Click the sign in link or button
Confirm user is redirected to /login route

test_cases.input: Click Sign In/Login button or link
test_cases.expected: Navigation occurs to '/login' route
Link/button has href='/login' or onClick navigates to '/login'

test_cases.input: Check Navbar component for login link
test_cases.expected: Navbar contains accessible login navigation
